name: agenttab
description: PayPal-funded spending tabs for AI agents, guarded by AI (Gemini). PayPal AI Hackathon entry by WebIntel Tools.

paragraphs: Lumen & Loom is a 6-person online shop selling home textiles and ceramics. Its AI agent orders supplier samples, buys SaaS seats and pays for competitor research. Giving that agent a company card is reckless; approving every $0.20 sample by hand defeats the point.
AgentTab gives the agent a prepaid tab and rules the owner writes in plain English:
Anything from a vendor that isn't on the list (follower sellers, gift cards) is blocked before any AI is asked.
features: Fund once with PayPal. The owner tops up the tab through PayPal Checkout (Orders v2: create → approve → capture).
Approved vendors, each with its own 30-day budget. SampleBox Wholesale $0.60, ShopSuite $1.00, WebIntel Data $0.30.
Approval above a threshold. A purchase over $0.30 isn't charged to the tab. AgentTab returns 202 with a
A refund window on goods and subscriptions. For 7 days each sample or SaaS purchase has its own Refund button:
